title: Running Totals reference solution
answer: SELECT order_date::date AS order_day, SUM(total_amount) AS daily_revenue, SUM(SUM(total_amount)) OVER (ORDER BY order_date::date) AS running_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY order_date::date ORDER BY order_day;
